## Architecture Overview

A containerized suite of AI microservices using:
- **FastAPI** (Python 3.12) for API endpoints
- **Docker/Traefik** for routing and deployment
- **Faster-Whisper / CTranslate2** for ASR
- **Hugging Face** integrations for sentiment/emotion analysis

### Entry Point: Traefik Reverse Proxy
All requests flow through Traefik. Production routing is **hostname-based**: every service owns
`https://<service-id>.api.mybister.com` (TLS via Let's Encrypt, `ForwardAuth` for API-key auth).
Development keeps path-based routing on `http://localhost/<service-id>/...`.

---

## Services Catalog

Endpoint paths below are relative to the service's own production hostname
(`https://<service-id>.api.mybister.com`).

| Service | Endpoint Pattern | Description |
|---------|-----------------|-------------|
| **ASR** (4 models) | `POST /v1/asr` (Host: `asr-{tiny\|small\|medium\|large}.api.mybister.com`) | Speech-to-text with auto-switch to async for files >5min |
| **ASR GPU (lokal)** | `POST /asr-*/v1/asr/gpu` | mlx-whisper on the Apple GPU, `word_timestamps` supported (local runs only) |
| **Sentiment** | `POST /v1/sentiment` | Multilingual sentiment analysis |
| **Emotion (Nuance)** | `POST /v1/emotion` (Host: `emotion-nuance.api.mybister.com`) | 28 fine-grained emotions |
| **Emotion (State)** | `POST /v1/emotion` (Host: `emotion-state.api.mybister.com`) | 7 core psychological states |
| **Emotion (Vibe)** | `POST /v1/emotion` (Host: `emotion-vibe.api.mybister.com`) | Star rating (1-5) emotion detection |
| **Diarization** | `POST /v1/diarize` | Full speaker timeline (`speakers: [{start,end,speaker}]`) |
| **Speaker Check** | `POST /v1/speaker-check` | Only `multi_speaker` + `number_speakers` |
| **Convert** | `POST /v1/convert` | ffmpeg audio conversion in a container (wav/mp3/flac/ogg/m4a) |
| **NER** | `POST /v1/ner` | Named entity recognition |
| **Barcode** | `POST /v1/barcode` | QR/code detection from images |
| **Food Recognition** | `POST /food-recognition/v1/detect` | Food item identification (not in compose yet) |
| **Debug Processor (Aggregator)** | `POST /v1/process` | Orchestrates ASR + all analyses in parallel |
| **Transcript** | `POST /v1/transcript` | Merges ASR + diarization into a speaker protocol (`[hh:mm:ss] Sprecher 1: ...`) |

### Async Processing Pattern
- Large files (>5min audio) auto-switch to async mode
- Job ID returned with status/download URLs
- Support for callback webhooks with Bearer token auth

## Development Workflow

### Start Dev Environment (Live Reload):
```bash
cd /Users/christianbister/PycharmProjects/com.mybister.apiservices
docker-compose --profile dev up asr-tiny-dev asr-small-dev sentiment-dev ...
```
- Code changes reload automatically (`UVICORN_RELOAD: "1"`)
- Debug logging enabled (`UVICORN_LOG_LEVEL: debug`)
- Local port 80 (no TLS)

### Start Production Environment:
```bash
docker-compose --profile prod up
```
- Uses published images from GHCR
- TLS via Let's Encrypt per service hostname (`<service-id>.api.mybister.com`)
- Optimized logging, no code mounts

### Local GPU runs (no Docker):
```bash
pip install -r requirements-local.txt   # pyannote 3.3.1 (Docker parity) + mlx-whisper
make local-asr          # :8100  /v1/asr + /v1/asr/gpu (mlx, Apple GPU)
make local-diarization  # :8101  /v1/speaker-check + /v1/diarize
make local-debug-processor    # :8102  /v1/process + /v1/transcript
```
Details: see README section "Local GPU Runs".

## Common Operations

### Log a specific service:
```bash
docker-compose logs -f asr-tiny-dev
```

### Check container health (returns hostname):
```bash
curl http://localhost/asr-tiny/v1/health | jq
```

### Make a test ASR request:
```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost/asr-tiny/v1/asr" \
  -F "file=@audio.wav" \
  -F "timestamps=true" \
  -o response.json
```

## Entry Points for Common Tasks

### Modify ASR logic:
Start in `/Users/christianbister/PycharmProjects/com.mybister.apiservices/asr-service/app` and edit `main.py` (FastAPI endpoints, transcription worker, job management)

### Add new service:
1. Create directory `new-feature-service/app/main.py` with FastAPI app
2. Update `docker-compose.yml`: add dev prod configs, Traefik labels  
3. Build image: `docker-compose build new-feature-image-builder --profile builder`

### Debug async jobs:
Check job persistence at `/srv/jobs/*.json` inside containers; view via `docker exec -it asr-tiny-dev ls /srv/jobs/`
